title: chore(deps): bump @objectstack/spec to ^9.0.1 (dataset-shaped reportForm)
body:
9.0.1 ships the `reportForm` fix from [framework#1730](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1730) — the bundled authoring form now declares `dataset` / `values` / `rows` / `runtimeFilter` natively (verified by dumping `reportForm.sections` from the installed package), so the local alignment pass in `report-schema.ts` degrades to a no-op as designed.
